high_level_description: This image captures a serene nighttime scene by the sea. The primary focus is on the moon, which is prominently positioned in the upper center of the frame, casting a soft glow over the water below. The moonlight reflects off the surface of the water, creating a shimmering path that leads towards the horizon. The sky is dark, with scattered clouds partially obscuring the moon, adding depth and texture to the scene. The foreground features a rocky shoreline, with some seaweed or vegetation visible in the lower part of the image.
